release_notes:
Canonicalize www to the bare domain — license is host-exact, www broke it

Hit this live: after adding ServerAlias www.$DOMAIN (for certbot's benefit),
Apache happily served the app on www.bestpriceunlock.com too, but
license_helper.php does an exact HTTP_HOST match against the single domain
on the license — so every www visitor got "This license is for domain
'bestpriceunlock.com', not 'www.bestpriceunlock.com'".

Added a redirect-to-bare-domain rule ahead of everything else in the
generated vhost. certbot's apache plugin copies the vhost's directives
(this rule included) into the :443 config when it later issues the cert, so
one fix in the :80 template covers both.
